# Vendored libraries

- `zxing-0.23.0.min.js` — [@zxing/library](https://github.com/zxing-js/library) 0.23.0, `umd/index.min.js`
  from the npm tarball (sha512-6fkkoFwP8CHxl6ugnPsj74PLJgX2iRv5zczGAyt5OBzQgxFhuhF0NCEc4t4OvSr8xAv2MRLlI0Iu9ZGDZQ2urA==).
  Apache-2.0, see `zxing-LICENSE.txt`. Reads barcodes from the camera where the browser has no
  BarcodeDetector (Safari on iPhone); loaded only when the scanner opens.
